title: Bee Swarm: CV→0 Autonomous Evolution Protocol — Implementation
description: PHP implementation of the CV→0 Autonomous Evolution Protocol: a population of autonomous agents (bees) that discover mathematical invariants through evolutionary search, evolve their own grammar bottom-up from verified discoveries (GRAMMAR-BIRTH), and structurally refuse to hallucinate (GRAMMAR/DATA/NOISE/DEPTH diagnosis). Includes null-calibration, held-out validation, cultural propagation, energy-based population dynamics, and 500+ TDD tests. Protocol v1.5: DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22003309.
